items.title: Author + land the effectiveness-proof development record as a decision-doc
items.context: Via decision_doc_proposal (sourceDecision=manual, slug=lattice-experience-layer-effectiveness-record) with structured fields (decision/context/scope/nonGoals/chosenApproach/alternatives>=2/operationalRules/verificationRequirements/risks) capturing: the six merged stories (IDs + what each is + key invariants), the evidence arc (Baseline A degraded lower-bound rho=-0.55 -> phase 3.5 real-signature held-out 62% -> live apply 656 signatures, recall 0.659, valid-rate 0.971), and the honesty guards (saturation not claimed; observational != causal; forward RCT pending). Then decision_doc_preview + decision_doc_save (mode=create, confirm=true) into docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-effectiveness-record.md.
items.userSees: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-effectiveness-record.md exists on main, rendering the development record.
excludes: No duplication of the lattice-Paper raw CSV/figure files

happy.desc: File exists at docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-effectiveness-record.md after decision_doc_save -> stat returns 0; WHY: canonical path correctness is the primary deliverable
Doc contains all six story IDs (B-a2e3, B-4eb6, B-5d48, B-06b3, B-c06a, B-17a9) -> grep finds each ID at least once; WHY: the record must enumerate every component story
Doc renders the evidence arc numbers: rho=-0.55, held-out 62%, 656 signatures, recall 0.659, valid-rate 0.971 -> grep finds each metric; WHY: these are the core quantitative claims
Doc contains honesty guards: saturation not claimed, observational != causal, forward RCT pending -> grep finds phrases for each guard; WHY: the record must not overclaim

Doc contains all required decision_doc structured sections (decision, context, scope, nonGoals, chosenApproach, alternatives, operationalRules, verificationRequirements, risks) -> heading grep finds each; WHY: decision_doc_proposal schema compliance

edge.desc: Doc does not duplicate raw lattice-Paper CSV or figure files into the repo -> find docs/requirements/decisions/ for .csv/.png/.svg returns only the .md file; WHY: excludes clause forbids raw-data duplication

Doc alternatives section lists at least 2 alternatives (degraded-signatures-only, cross-project aggregation, or persist-without-evidence) -> parse heading/bullet count >= 2; WHY: decision_doc_proposal requires alternatives>=2
File is valid UTF-8 Markdown with no binary content -> file(1) reports text/markdown; WHY: ensures the doc is renderable

adversarial.desc: Doc contains no CJK/non-ASCII characters -> grep -P "[^\x00-\x7F]" returns empty; WHY: english-artifacts gate requires ASCII-only content

Doc does not claim causal proof (phrases like "causally proven", "causal evidence", "proves that") -> grep returns empty for causal-claim patterns; WHY: the causal result is deferred to the forward RCT, overclaiming is a factual error
Doc does not claim saturation curve is real signal (phrases like "saturation proves", "rising curve demonstrates") -> grep returns empty; WHY: saturation is a known confound and must not be claimed
No source/CLI/handler/gate code files modified in the commit -> git diff --name-only against base shows only the .md file under docs/; WHY: excludes clause forbids code changes in this story

items.title: Verify recorded facts are accurate, English-only, and cross-refs resolve
items.context: Confirm the recorded story IDs (B-a2e3/B-4eb6/B-5d48/B-06b3/B-c06a/B-17a9) and the main commit (2750aadef) exist; the live numbers are reproducible on main (learning_scan ~320 signals; learning_effectiveness recall ~0.659; learning_validate valid-rate ~0.971); the doc is ASCII/English-only (english-artifacts gate); and the Work/lattice-Paper/ references name real files. docs reviewer checks doc-vs-code consistency.
items.userSees: The recorded facts match main and the doc passes the docs review + english-artifacts gate.
excludes: No re-running the heavy analysis (reference the committed lattice-Paper artifacts)

happy.desc: Each of the six story IDs (B-a2e3, B-4eb6, B-5d48, B-06b3, B-c06a, B-17a9) resolves to a real Lattice story -> lattice story_get for each returns valid JSON without error; WHY: recorded IDs must reference real stories
Commit 2750aadef exists in git history on main -> git log --oneline 2750aadef returns a valid entry; WHY: the commit hash is a factual claim that must be verifiable
learning_scan on main returns approximately 320 signals -> run learning_scan and check count is in range 280-360; WHY: the live number must be reproducible within tolerance
learning_effectiveness on main returns recall approximately 0.659 -> run and check recall is in range 0.60-0.72; WHY: the recall claim must be reproducible
learning_validate on main returns valid-rate approximately 0.971 -> run and check valid-rate is in range 0.95-0.99; WHY: the valid-rate claim must be reproducible

edge.desc: Work/lattice-Paper/ references in the doc name files that actually exist on disk -> extract referenced filenames and stat each; WHY: cross-refs must resolve to real artifacts
Doc references to story IDs match the correct story titles (not swapped or misattributed) -> compare story_get title for each ID against what the doc says; WHY: ID-to-description mapping accuracy
Doc passes the english-artifacts gate -> run the gate check (or grep -P "[^\x00-\x7F]") and confirm clean; WHY: the gate is a hard blocker for DONE

adversarial.desc: Stale or fabricated metrics: if learning_effectiveness recall has drifted beyond tolerance (outside 0.55-0.75) the doc number is flagged as potentially stale -> compare live output vs doc claim; WHY: numbers recorded at authoring time can become stale after code changes

CJK characters injected into the doc (e.g., via copy-paste from Chinese notes) -> grep -P "[\x{4E00}-\x{9FFF}]" returns empty; WHY: english-artifacts gate rejects non-ASCII, and the operator communicates in Chinese so accidental leakage is a real risk

Doc overclaims causal relationship (uses phrases like "caused by", "due to the Experience Layer", "proves effectiveness") without the deferred-RCT qualifier -> grep for causal-claim patterns near the conclusion/summary sections returns empty or is accompanied by the deferral caveat; WHY: observational != causal is a core honesty guard

Doc embeds raw CSV data or large data tables copied from lattice-Paper instead of referencing them -> line count of the .md file is reasonable (<500 lines) and no CSV-formatted blocks exist; WHY: the excludes clause forbids duplicating raw data
